item.title: Drupal Developer @ Monarch Digital
item.description:
Drupal Developer @ Monarch Digital
Date Range
Jun 2022 - Oct 2024
Brandon Weigand Thu, 01/23/2025 - 21:29
Location Link
Colorado Springs, CO
Info

Monarch Digital

As a Drupal Developer at Monarch Digital, I was responsible for maintaining, updating, and optimizing Drupal, WordPress, and custom PHP applications. I collaborated with cross-functional teams to ensure that client websites and digital platforms were running efficiently, securely, and with the latest features and updates. My role primarily involved developing custom modules, themes, and functionalities tailored to meet the unique needs of each client, leveraging Drupal’s extensive flexibility to deliver highly customizable web solutions.

A significant portion of my work involved troubleshooting and debugging existing Drupal and WordPress systems to ensure that performance issues were addressed promptly, security patches were applied, and new updates were implemented without disrupting the site’s functionality. 

In addition to my development work, I contributed to ensuring that the websites we developed complied with accessibility standards for government sites. This involved implementing features and adjustments to meet WCAG (Web Content Accessibility Guidelines), improving site usability for people with disabilities, and ensuring that the sites met the necessary compliance requirements for government agencies.

Key Skills Developed:

  • Drupal Development (Modules, Themes, and Customization)
  • WordPress Development and Maintenance
  • PHP Application Development and Optimization
  • Troubleshooting, Debugging, and Site Maintenance
  • Web Performance Optimization (Page Load Speed, SEO)
  • Accessibility Compliance (WCAG, ADA)
  • Security Updates and Patches for Web Applications

  • Software Engineering

item.title: Full Stack Web Developer @ BlankU_Interactive
item.description:
Full Stack Web Developer @ BlankU_Interactive
Date Range
May 2005 - Aug 2022
Brandon Weigand Thu, 01/23/2025 - 21:23
Location Link
Houma, LA | Ithaca, NY

As a Full Stack Web Developer at BlankU_Interactive, I played a key role in designing, creating, and maintaining interactive web experiences, focusing on seamless UI/UX design to ensure user-centric and visually appealing interfaces. I was responsible for developing both front-end and back-end solutions, utilizing a wide range of technologies including HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP. I worked closely with clients to understand their vision and objectives, delivering custom solutions tailored to their needs while ensuring optimal performance and scalability.

In addition to web development, I managed and maintained LAMP (Linux, Apache, MySQL, PHP) servers, ensuring the smooth operation of hosting environments for various client websites and applications. My responsibilities included troubleshooting server issues, implementing security protocols, and performing regular backups and updates to ensure data integrity and availability. This role strengthened my expertise in server administration and the overall web hosting infrastructure, allowing me to provide clients with reliable and secure hosting services.

As part of my role, I also contributed to sales efforts by providing technical insights during client consultations, helping to drive business growth by aligning web solutions with client goals. I collaborated with the sales team to create tailored proposals and ensure the technical feasibility of projects, often bridging the gap between client expectations and development capabilities. Additionally, I oversaw the project management aspect of web development, coordinating timelines, resources, and team members to ensure successful project delivery within scope and budget.

Key Skills Developed:

  • Full Stack Web Development (UI/UX, Front-End, Back-End)
  • LAMP Server Management and Maintenance
  • Client Relations and Sales Support
  • Project Management and Team Leadership
  • Troubleshooting and Security Protocols
  • Web Hosting and Server Administration
  • Custom Web Solutions and Interactive Design
  • Technical Proposal Development

item.description:
Leasing Consultant @ 312 College Avenue
Date Range
Aug 2017 - Aug 2018
Brandon Weigand Thu, 01/23/2025 - 20:57
Location Link
Ithaca, NY
Info

312 College Ave

As a Leasing Consultant at 312 College Avenue Management, I played a pivotal role in managing leasing operations for residential properties, ensuring both tenant satisfaction and high occupancy rates. I was responsible for arranging leasing units, which involved coordinating showings, processing applications, and managing lease agreements. My attention to detail ensured all leasing procedures adhered to company policies while providing a positive experience for prospective tenants.

In addition to leasing responsibilities, I was committed to maintaining excellent service standards for current tenants. I addressed tenant concerns and inquiries, coordinated maintenance requests, and ensured the property was well-maintained to promote tenant retention and satisfaction. I effectively communicated with both prospective and current tenants to ensure their needs were met and helped cultivate a welcoming and professional environment.

This role strengthened my sales and negotiation skills, as I worked closely with prospective tenants to understand their needs and find suitable rental units. I also gained valuable experience in customer service and conflict resolution, managing tenant relationships and ensuring their concerns were promptly addressed. My ability to balance multiple responsibilities while maintaining high service standards was critical to the success of the leasing process.

Key Skills Developed:

  • Leasing and Property Management
  • Customer Service and Client Relations
  • Sales and Negotiation
  • Conflict Resolution and Problem Solving
  • Tenant Communication and Retention
  • Organization and Time Management
  • Attention to Detail and Documentation
